offer.text: It is already in them. A golden apple and a steady hand — and do it where the others cannot see, they are frightened enough.

accept.text: Quickly. It moves faster at night.

decline.text: Then somebody will have to do the other thing, and I will not ask who.

in_progress.text: Still turning. There is still time.

ready.text: Look at them. They know their own name again.

complete.text: We nearly lost somebody tonight and we did not. That is the whole of it.

failed.text: It finished. We locked the door and we will not talk about it.
